items.description: todo-1 and todo-2 are coupled through the formatMoney signature even though no file is written by both — todo-2's module does not exist yet. money.ts states 'Every user-visible amount goes through here ... formatting an amount inline anywhere else is a review blocker', and all three existing amount renderers import it, so the receipt todo-2 writes must call formatMoney too. todo-1 is changing that call signature to take a currency code, so a receipt authored concurrently is written against a signature that stops existing. Establishing this requires deriving the file set of a module that has not been written.

todo-1 and todo-3 are coupled through src/notify/email.ts. todo-1 says to update 'every place that calls it today', and sendDueNotice is one of the three call sites (formatMoney imported at :1, called at :17) — so todo-1's sweep writes email.ts. todo-3 rewrites sendDueNotice in that same file to add the retry. A mechanical sweep across a hub's call sites is not coupled to anything by itself, but it is coupled to any todo that edits one of those call sites.
